blockers.detail: The latest review found that the published bootstrap declaration exposes NodeJS.ProcessEnv even though @types/node is only a devDependency, and that top-level/fallback serialization permits distinct command objects with the same ID to route ambiguously.
blockers.remediation: Replace the public NodeJS.ProcessEnv type with a structural environment map (or ship the dependency), and reject duplicate IDs belonging to distinct command objects during a serialization pass.
